question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**legend**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Legend**" means a famous or important person who is known for their achievements or qualities. (दंतकथा)

 
 
• **For example**: *Sachin Tendulkar is a cricketing legend.*
 
 
 
• Grammatically, "legend" is the correct option to fill in the blank.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Lagend**", is a misspelling of "legend".
 
• "**Verity**", means truth or accuracy. (हक़ीक़त)
 
• "**Candour**", means honesty or frankness. (स्पष्टवादिता)
